messages.subject: Special Characters: encoding problems between Shiny and ggplot2
parts:
Hi all, as you may know working with special characters (á,à,é,è,í,ó,ú,ñ) is a nightmare. 

After uploading my app I had some problems with accents on the ui (sidebarpanel).  

Andy Kipp, was really kind and help me to solve that problem (converting my data file to UTF-8), 
but know the problem is that in the plot (produced using ggplot2) special characters are not shown.

Do anyone know how to deal with this issue?
Thanks in advanced

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Special Characters: encoding problems between Shiny and ggplot2
parts:
Hello,

I encountered a problem somewhat similar to Juan's one: when I deployed my app with shiny 0.9, it worked, but threw an error popup about misformed JSON when I read and displayed (with renderDataTable) CSV files with non-ASCII character. The CSV files and all the files of the shiny app are encoded in UTF-8, and the app sets the locale of the server to fr_FR.UTF-8. 
Otherwise, the app works perfectly fine both locally (Ubuntu) and on my server with Shiny server open source (Ubuntu as well, see http://www.joelgombin.fr:3838/shiny/LireMinInterieur/).

So I tried to upgrade shiny to 0.10, hoping that it would work better on shinyapps.io. But now, it doesn't work at all, it seems that non-ASCII characters crash shiny all along: I get an 'unexpected INCOMPLETE_STRING' error, see https://gombin.shinyapps.io/LireMinInterieur/. 

Any idea what may be going wrong? The sourcecode of the app can be found here: https://github.com/joelgombin/LireMinInterieur/tree/master/inst/liremininterieur

Thanks!

Joel
